spec.curation_sources: ChronAeon exponential time-decay (t_1/2=0.25 yr) across 16 spanning Tier-1 founder profiles paired with circulating clade-stem profiles for 12 pure callers + 16 Tier-2 recombinants (10,062 Global Union + BV-BRC dated assemblies); clock-calibrated via ChronAeon Steiner+Gamma4 and IQ-TREE 2/LSD2/TreeTime.
spec.certification_criteria: 4-gate guarded caller on Wuhan-Hu-1 coding coordinates (266..29674); default 5-SNP Fisher floor (p < 1e-4, gamma = 7.0) or CoV 4-SNP mode (min_snps = 3, p < 0.01, gamma = 3.5)
